title: Kevin Davitt Explains Why Leveraged ETFs Secretly Amplify Every Market Move
speaker: Kevin Davitt (Nasdaq), with tastylive host

macro_themes.view: Levered products like SOXL are inherently short gamma and amplify market moves via end-of-day rebalancing flows.
The Nasdaq-100 had been rising alongside higher rates until the past 5-10 days, when that paused.
Watching for inflections in NDX put/call skew through big earnings over the next two weeks.

notes: Educational/flow discussion only. Mentions Nasdaq-100 rolling 5-day return near -4% looked 'ripe for a bounce' (seen the prior day) but explicitly says 'What it means looking ahead, I don't know.' No directional calls recorded. Date: host says Friday; listing 2026-10-17, set to Friday 2026-10-16.
